extracted.name: Cranberry vanilla cup cakes
instruction_lines: Mix dry ingredients, add gradually to wet mixture,add milk if mixture becomes thick. Mix well add vanilla essence. Put some all-purpose flour to cranberries
Preheat OTG at 180 degrees for ten minutes.put liner to cup cake moulds. Fill moulds 3/4. Put it in the OTG for 15 minutes.check with toothpick.let it cool and serve.
